name: Step Away
description: A quiet screen for when you step away from the desk while your agents work. Shows how long you have been away, offers an optional slow breathing cue and a few gentle ideas for your break.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A quiet screen for a real break while your agents work. It counts how long you have been away.
help.goal: Nothing to win. Rest your eyes and come back when Lullshift calls you.
howToPlay: Open it as you leave your desk. The clock shows your time away.
If you like, start the breathing cue and follow the circle: breathe in as it grows, out as it shrinks.
Press Another idea for a different suggestion for your break.

controls.action: Start or stop the breathing cue, or show another idea

tips: When an agent needs you, Lullshift pauses this screen and tells you which one.
With reduced motion on, the circle stays still and the words lead your breathing.
